title: Pinned tool releases
description: The release of each first-party tool commitwork runs, by version, tag, asset URL, sha256 and commit. A pinned tool is resolved from its verified install under CW_TOOLS_ROOT (default ~/.commitwork/tools), never from PATH. Upgrading is an edit to this file in a commit. Read by lib/cobolwork-resolve.mjs and bin/cobolwork-pin.mjs.

url.description: Must equal https://github.com/<repo>/releases/download/<tag>/<asset>; the reader refuses a pin whose url and parts disagree.

sha256.description: Of the release asset. An install refuses other bytes before extracting anything.

commit.description: The commit the tag names, which the installed package's lib/revision.json must state.
